invariants.name: invariant_backingOverCollateralized
invariants.description: phUSD debt (outstanding + realised) never exceeds 50% of gross 18dp-scaled prime dispatched; the >=2:1 over-backing buffer (2*debt <= grossPrimeScaled).

invariants.name: invariant_debtMatchesGhostExpectation
invariants.description: Outstanding mintDebt equals an independent ghost re-derivation of sum(floor(amount*scale*ratio/100)); realised mint matches too. No over-mint; rounding dust floors to the protocol.

invariants.name: invariant_ratioWithinBound
invariants.description: Live ratio <= MAX_RATIO (50) at all times; setRatio(>50) reverts RatioTooHigh.

invariants.name: invariant_noDebtResurrection
invariants.description: pull() mints exactly the outstanding debt and zeroes it; total minted phUSD equals ghost realised; no double-pull / debt resurrection.
